name: New York City
summary: The trip's marquee stay — plan on two to three weeks. These are the anchor days; the full build expands them across the boroughs and seasons.
seasonalTip: NYC is all-season — take whatever slot the loop gives you and lean in (ballgames and rooftops in summer; the Rockefeller tree, skating, and holiday windows near winter).

lodging.name: A classic Midtown or Village hotel
lodging.blurb: Base near a subway hub; Midtown and the Village both put most anchors a short ride away.

foodMustTry.name: Pastrami on rye at Katz's Delicatessen
foodMustTry.blurb: The definitive New York deli since 1888.

foodMustTry.name: A classic New York slice
foodMustTry.blurb: Fold it. Joe's in the Village is a reliable benchmark.

days.label: Day 18 — Liberty, Ellis Island & Lower Manhattan
days.summary: Start at the harbor icons and the 9/11 Memorial.

item.title: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island ferry
item.blurb: Ferry to Liberty Island (book crown or pedestal ahead) and the deeply moving Ellis Island immigration museum.

item.title: 9/11 Memorial & Museum
item.blurb: The twin reflecting pools in the towers' footprints, and a museum that handles the day with extraordinary care.

days.label: Day 19 — Midtown Icons
days.summary: The skyline from above, the park, and the museum mile.

item.title: Top of the Rock observation deck
item.blurb: The best skyline view because it puts the Empire State Building in your photo. Go early to beat the lines.

item.title: Walk Central Park
item.blurb: Bethesda Terrace, the Mall, and the Bow Bridge — 843 acres in the middle of Manhattan.

item.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
item.blurb: One of the greatest museums on earth — pick a few wings; you can't do it all in a day.

days.label: Day 20 — Broadway & the Village
days.summary: Downtown by day, a show by night, late laughs after.

item.title: Walk the High Line
item.blurb: An elevated park on old freight rails from the Meatpacking District to Hudson Yards.

item.title: A Broadway show
item.blurb: Whatever's playing, this is the pinnacle of American theater. TKTS and lotteries help with tickets.

item.title: The Comedy Cellar
item.blurb: The most famous comedy club in the country — legendary drop-in sets. Reserve ahead.

days.label: Day 21 — Free Day (deep menu)
days.summary: In a stay this long you'll want several of these. A sampler of the optional bench.

freeMenu.title: An event at Madison Square Garden
freeMenu.blurb: The world's most famous arena — Knicks, Rangers, or a concert. Go for whatever's on while you're here.

freeMenu.title: Yankees game in the Bronx
freeMenu.blurb: If you land in baseball season, the pinstripes are an American bucket-list game.

freeMenu.title: Walk the Brooklyn Bridge to DUMBO
freeMenu.blurb: Cross into Brooklyn for the classic Manhattan Bridge photo and pizza at Grimaldi's.

freeMenu.title: Pastrami at Katz's Delicatessen

location.name: Katz's Delicatessen
location.address: 205 E Houston St, New York, NY

freeMenu.blurb: Hand-cut pastrami on rye at the 1888 institution on the Lower East Side.

days.label: Day 22 — Drive to Philadelphia
days.summary: South out of the city into Pennsylvania.

commute.scenicNote: Short hop; time it outside NYC rush hour.
